items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I had Gus Green too, bass.

ctx.x: Sax. Nice sax. I was playing with Glenny, some time. I had Gus Green too, bass. I had, what's that boy, Shelly was playing with the Glen brothers? Played piano with Simon Fraser. Mm-hmm. Piano. Right, a fellow by the name of Right, tenor sax. I think it was Walter, Henry Wright, I don't know if he's working today. In the age too, I guess. How many fellows out the game, you know. Oh yeah. I didn't turn it. Instead they out. Well what about guys like Chris and Buddy and Boots and Boots and? Who's playing with the…
Well, what about guys like Chris and Buddy and... Who was that guy? Chris and Buddy and Rene and all those, would you play any second trumpet to them ever?
